items.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) is announcing an opportunity for the public to comment on CMS' intention to collect information from the public. Under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA), federal agencies are required to publish notice in the Federal Register concerning each proposed collection of information, including each proposed extension or reinstatement of an existing collection of information, and to allow a second opportunity for public comment on the notice. Interested persons are invited to send comments regarding the burden estimate or any other aspect of this collection of information, including the necessity and utility of the proposed information…
items.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request

items.subcategory: Proposed rule
items.summary: The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is proposing to approve the negative declarations submitted by the West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection (WVDEP) on July 13, 2026. The negative declarations submitted by WVDEP certify that there are no existing large municipal waste combustors (LMWC) or other solid waste incinerators (OSWI) subject to sections 111(d) and 129 of the Clean Air Act (CAA) within the jurisdiction of West Virginia.
items.title: Approval and Promulgation of State Air Quality Plans for Designated Facilities and Pollutants; West Virginia; Negative Declarations for Existing Large Municipal Waste Combustors and Other Solid Waste Incinerators

items.subcategory: Other notice
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is correcting a notice that appeared in the Federal Register of September 13, 2023 (88 FR 62799). The notice announced the determination that Oxandrin (oxandrolone) tablets, 2.5 milligrams (mg) and 10 mg, were withdrawn from sale for reasons of safety or effectiveness. The notice did not include the determination that the abbreviated new drug applications (ANDAs) referencing Oxandrin (oxandrolone) tablets, 2.5 mg and 10 mg, were also determined to be withdrawn from sale for reasons of safety or effectiveness and that these ANDAs would be removed from "Approved Drug Products With Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations," which is known generally as the…
items.title: Determination That Oxandrin (Oxandrolone) Tablets, 2.5 Milligrams and 10 Milligrams, Were Withdrawn From Sale for Reasons of Safety or Effectiveness; Correction

items.summary: The Department of Labor (Department) is withdrawing its notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM) published on July 2, 2025 (90 FR 28985), which proposed to remove parts located in Title 29, Chapter V, Subchapter B of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) that were not originally issued, or subsequently amended, through notice-and-comment rulemaking. With this action, the Department is formally discontinuing this rulemaking process and removing this proposal from further consideration.
